summary: A popup that asks for a decision, like allowing a permission, anchored under the address bar.
description: A XUL widget rendering a single doorhanger notification (icon, origin, description, optional checkbox/warning/hint, close button, and primary/secondary moz-button pair) inside the panel managed by PopupNotifications.sys.mjs. Light-DOM widget: child elements are placed by tag-name lookup (querySelector) rather than native <slot> projection.

attributes.name: popupid
attributes.description: Forwarded to the icon, body, and description parts; used to build data-l10n-id-style identifiers for the notification.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Inherited as src on .popup-notification-icon.

attributes.name: iconclass
attributes.description: Inherited as an additional class on .popup-notification-icon.

attributes.name: hasicon
attributes.description: Inherited presence flag forwarded to .popup-notification-icon.

attributes.name: origin
attributes.description: Inherited as both the value and tooltiptext of the .popup-notification-origin link (the site/origin the notification is about).

attributes.name: descriptionid
attributes.description: Inherited as the id of .popup-notification-description.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Inherited as the first text span in the compound description sentence.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Inherited as the bold '.popup-notification-description-name' span (e.g. a site or permission name).

attributes.name: endlabel
attributes.description: Inherited as the second text span in the description.

attributes.name: secondname
attributes.description: Inherited as the trailing bold span in the description.

attributes.name: secondendlabel
attributes.description: Inherited as the final text span in the description.

attributes.name: hinttext
attributes.description: Inherited as the text of .popup-notification-hint-text, a secondary line below the main description.

attributes.name: closebuttonhidden
attributes.description: Inherited as hidden on the close toolbarbutton.

attributes.name: learnmoreurl
attributes.description: Inherited as href on the 'Learn more' link.

attributes.name: warninghidden
attributes.description: Inherited as hidden on the warning description.

attributes.name: warninglabel
attributes.description: Inherited as the text of the warning description.

attributes.name: secondarybuttonlabel
attributes.description: Inherited as the label of the secondary moz-button.

attributes.name: secondarybuttonaccesskey
attributes.description: Inherited as the accesskey of the secondary moz-button.

attributes.name: secondarybuttonhidden
attributes.description: Inherited as hidden on both the secondary button and the 'more actions' menupopup.

attributes.name: buttonlabel
attributes.description: Inherited as the label of the primary moz-button.

attributes.name: buttonaccesskey
attributes.description: Inherited as the accesskey of the primary moz-button.

attributes.name: mainactiondisabled
attributes.description: Inherited as disabled on the primary moz-button.

attributes.name: dropmarkerhidden
attributes.description: When present, forces the secondary button's type to "default" instead of "split" (hiding its chevron/menu affordance).

slots.name: popupnotificationheader
slots.description: Not a real <slot> — a child element with this tag name is moved into the header container above the icon/body row, if present.

slots.name: popupnotificationcontent
slots.description: Not a real <slot> — each child element with this tag name is appended before .popup-notification-bottom-content via appendNotificationContent(); repeatable.

slots.name: popupnotificationfooter
slots.description: Not a real <slot> — a child element with this tag name is moved into the footer container below the body, if present.

events.name: buttoncommand
events.description: Cancelable CustomEvent dispatched on primary-button click; if not canceled, forwarded to PopupNotifications._onButtonEvent.

events.name: secondarybuttoncommand
events.description: Cancelable CustomEvent dispatched on secondary-button click (when the click wasn't on the chevron); forwarded to PopupNotifications._onButtonEvent if not canceled.

events.name: learnmoreclick
events.description: Cancelable CustomEvent dispatched when the 'Learn more' link is clicked.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Lazily slots content (slotContents()) on first call, applies checkbox state, and un-hides the notification.

methods.name: appendNotificationContent
methods.description: appendNotificationContent(el): inserts an extra content element before the bottom-content box.

cssProperties.name: --popup-notification-body-width
cssProperties.description: Default width basis for the notification body and icon/body max-width calculations; defined globally in toolkit/themes/shared/global-shared.css, consumed in popupnotification.css.

usage:
<popupnotification popupid="geolocation" label="Share your location?" buttonlabel="Allow" secondarybuttonlabel="Block">
  <popupnotificationcontent>...</popupnotificationcontent>
</popupnotification>
